fields.accordionHeading: Where can I update my race/ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, and pronouns?
fields.accordionDescription: You can update your race/ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, and pronouns under Account Settings under Communication Preferences. This is important so we can provide better care, services, and programs. Updating these fields are optional.
